acceptance_criteria: Provide electrical safety/EMC testing per applicable standards (IEC 60601).
Demonstrate equivalent thermal/energy output under worst-case conditions.
Map all energy-related hazards to controls and verification evidence.

anticipated_questions.question: The energy source differs from the predicate. Identify all new hazards and provide bench testing evidence demonstrating safety.
Has thermal/energy output equivalence been demonstrated under worst-case conditions?

tasks.title: Verify safety and performance impact of energy source change
tasks.why_it_matters: Energy source differences change the hazard profile. FDA commonly requires electrical safety, EMC, and bench verification.

acceptance_criteria: Provide ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation rationale and endpoint coverage.
If testing required, attach final test reports and acceptance criteria.
Provide chemical characterization data for new materials.

anticipated_questions.question: Identify the material change and provide ISO 10993 biological evaluation justifying biocompatibility.
Has chemical characterization been performed per ISO 10993-18 for the new material?

tasks.title: Assess biocompatibility impact of material change
tasks.why_it_matters: Material changes can alter biological response. FDA expects ISO 10993 justification and testing as needed.

acceptance_criteria: Update ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation for new contact type.
Identify additional biocompatibility endpoints required by new contact type.
Provide residual risk / benefit-risk justification for contact change.

anticipated_questions.question: The tissue contact type has changed. What additional biocompatibility endpoints are now applicable per ISO 10993-1?

tasks.title: Evaluate impact of tissue contact type change
tasks.why_it_matters: Change in tissue contact type (e.g., intact skin → blood contact) requires updated biocompatibility evaluation per ISO 10993-1.

acceptance_criteria: Conduct systematic literature review for applicable clinical evidence.
If literature insufficient, develop clinical study protocol.
Provide clinical rationale memo justifying evidence sufficiency.

anticipated_questions.question: Bench testing may be insufficient. What clinical evidence or literature supports the claims?

tasks.title: Provide clinical evidence to address identified gaps
tasks.why_it_matters: Bench data alone may not support claim differences. Clinical evidence or systematic literature review likely needed to close the gap.

acceptance_criteria: Provide side-by-side intended use comparison with predicate.
Justify any differences with clinical evidence or bench bridging.
Confirm labeling/IFU reflects aligned indications.

anticipated_questions.question: How does the subject device's intended use differ from the predicate, and what evidence supports the claim of substantial equivalence despite these differences?
Have the indications for use been narrowed or broadened vs. the predicate? Provide specific language comparison.

tasks.title: Align intended use and indications with predicate
tasks.why_it_matters: Intended use mismatch is the leading cause of NSE determinations. FDA expects identical or narrower intended use for SE claims.

acceptance_criteria: Provide clinical evidence (literature or study) supporting expanded population.
Document risk/benefit analysis for new indications.
Attach clinical protocol / study plan if prospective data needed.

anticipated_questions.question: What clinical evidence supports the expanded indications beyond the predicate's cleared scope?

tasks.title: Justify expanded indications for use
tasks.why_it_matters: Broader indications require clinical evidence supporting the expanded patient population, use environment, or anatomical site.

acceptance_criteria: Provide SBOM with all software components and versions.
Attach threat model and security risk assessment.
Document vulnerability management and patch/update process.
Provide penetration testing summary if applicable.

anticipated_questions.question: The device has increased connectivity. Provide threat model, SBOM, and vulnerability assessment.
Describe the patch/update process and how security vulnerabilities will be addressed post-market.

tasks.title: Provide cybersecurity evidence for increased attack surface
tasks.why_it_matters: Increased network/cloud/mobile connectivity increases cybersecurity attack surface. SBOM, threat model, and vulnerability assessment required.

acceptance_criteria: Document known safety signals for chosen predicate (recalls, MDRs).
Provide risk/benefit justification for continuing with this predicate.
Consider identifying alternate predicate without safety concerns.
Attach recall/safety signal summary with disposition.

anticipated_questions.question: The chosen predicate has elevated safety signals. Justify continued use or identify alternate predicate.
Provide analysis of predicate recalls/MDRs and explain why the subject device mitigates those concerns.

tasks.title: Justify continued use of predicate with elevated safety signals
tasks.why_it_matters: Predicate has elevated safety signals (recalls, MDRs). Provide risk justification or consider alternate predicate.

acceptance_criteria: Document predicate lineage and associated safety events.
Provide risk management file addressing lineage concerns.
If lineage toxicity is significant, provide alternate predicate analysis.
Attach CAPA summary for any open corrective actions in lineage.

anticipated_questions.question: The predicate family has safety concerns (cascading recalls). Document lineage analysis and risk controls.
Has an alternate predicate with a clean safety lineage been evaluated?

tasks.title: Address compromised predicate family safety lineage
tasks.why_it_matters: Predicate family tree shows safety concerns (cascading recalls, warning letters). Document risk controls and consider alternate lineage.

acceptance_criteria: Classify software level of concern (Class A/B/C per IEC 62304).
Provide software development lifecycle plan and artifacts.
Attach V&V summary, traceability matrix, and SOUP/OTS list.
Provide SBOM and threat model for cybersecurity review.

anticipated_questions.question: The subject introduces software not present in the predicate. Provide IEC 62304 software lifecycle documentation and level of concern classification.
Provide SBOM and cybersecurity documentation for the new software component.

tasks.title: Provide software lifecycle evidence for new/updated software
tasks.why_it_matters: Subject introduces software not present in predicate. Full IEC 62304 lifecycle documentation and cybersecurity review required.

acceptance_criteria: Provide Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) for adaptive algorithms.
Document training/validation dataset characteristics and bias analysis.
Attach performance monitoring plan with drift detection methodology.
Provide algorithm verification evidence under expected operating conditions.

anticipated_questions.question: The device uses adaptive ML/AI. Provide the Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) and performance monitoring methodology.
Describe the training/validation dataset, bias analysis, and expected operating conditions.

tasks.title: Provide ML/AI controls and predetermined change control plan
tasks.why_it_matters: ML/AI model adaptivity requires a predetermined change control plan (PCCP) and performance monitoring evidence per FDA AI/ML guidance.

acceptance_criteria: Provide interface specification and interoperability test protocol.
Attach test results demonstrating accurate data exchange under fault conditions.
If applicable, provide vulnerability assessment for connected interfaces.

anticipated_questions.question: What interoperability claims are made, and what testing validates safe and accurate data exchange?

tasks.title: Provide interoperability testing and data integrity evidence
tasks.why_it_matters: New interoperability claims require interface testing and data integrity evidence demonstrating safe data exchange.

acceptance_criteria: Provide bench test protocol with acceptance criteria for each performance claim.
Attach bench test report demonstrating claim verification.
If claims cannot be verified by bench alone, provide clinical bridging analysis.

anticipated_questions.question: Provide bench test data with acceptance criteria supporting changed performance claims.

tasks.title: Verify performance claims with bench/clinical evidence
tasks.why_it_matters: Performance claim changes require bench testing with defined acceptance criteria and may require clinical bridging analysis.

acceptance_criteria: Provide design comparison document (subject vs. predicate architecture).
Attach bench test results demonstrating equivalent performance.
Document risk analysis addressing new design-related hazards.

anticipated_questions.question: How does the design architecture differ, and what verification evidence supports equivalent performance?

tasks.title: Verify design architecture equivalence with predicate
tasks.why_it_matters: Design architecture changes require verification/validation demonstrating equivalent performance and safety characteristics.

acceptance_criteria: Provide bench test protocol and results comparing subject vs. predicate performance.
Map technology differences to risk analysis and hazard controls.
Demonstrate equivalent performance under worst-case conditions.

anticipated_questions.question: Describe the core technology differences and provide bench/analytical data supporting equivalent performance and safety.
Does the technology change introduce new biocompatibility, electrical safety, or software risk concerns not present in the predicate?

tasks.title: Demonstrate substantial equivalence despite technology differences
tasks.why_it_matters: Core technology differences require bench or analytical testing to show the new technology does not raise new safety/effectiveness questions.

acceptance_criteria: Update ISO 10993-1 evaluation to address new duration category.
If moving to longer duration, provide additional endpoint testing evidence.
Document rationale for any endpoint exemptions.

anticipated_questions.question: Contact duration category has changed. Provide updated biocompatibility evaluation per ISO 10993-1 Table A.1.

tasks.title: Evaluate impact of contact duration category change
tasks.why_it_matters: Change in contact duration category (limited/prolonged/permanent) may require additional biocompatibility endpoints per ISO 10993-1.

acceptance_criteria: Conduct formative and/or summative human factors studies.
Document use-related risk analysis and mitigations.
Update IFU to reflect any workflow or interface changes.

anticipated_questions.question: The user interface or workflow has changed. Provide human factors validation evidence.

tasks.title: Validate human factors for changed user interface
tasks.why_it_matters: Changes to user interface or workflow require human factors validation and updated IFU per FDA human factors guidance.

acceptance_criteria: Provide complaint trending analysis for predicate and subject (if on market).
Attach CAPA summary for any open corrective actions.
If applicable, provide PSUR / PMCF trigger memo.

anticipated_questions.question: Post-market signals have been identified. Provide complaint trending and CAPA documentation.

tasks.title: Document post-market surveillance signals and mitigations
tasks.why_it_matters: Post-market signals suggest heightened scrutiny. Provide complaint trending and CAPA documentation to demonstrate risk control.

acceptance_criteria: Document software safety classification rationale (IEC 62304 Class A/B/C).
If higher class, provide enhanced V&V evidence commensurate with risk.
Provide traceability between requirements, design, and verification.

anticipated_questions.question: Software safety classification differs. Justify the classification and provide V&V evidence commensurate with the risk level.

tasks.title: Justify software safety classification difference
tasks.why_it_matters: Software safety classification differs from predicate. Provide classification justification and appropriate V&V evidence per IEC 62304.

acceptance_criteria: Provide applicable recognized standards list and gap analysis.
For each gap, provide rationale for alternative approach or test evidence.
Attach conformance test summaries where applicable.

anticipated_questions.question: No recognized consensus standard covers the identified differences. Provide rationale for the alternative approach.

tasks.title: Provide standards conformance rationale for identified gaps
tasks.why_it_matters: No recognized consensus standard covers the identified differences. Provide rationale or alternative test evidence.

acceptance_criteria: Provide sterilization validation summary (SAL 10^-6 or as applicable).
If EO sterilization, provide residuals report within ISO 10993-7 limits.
Demonstrate package integrity maintained under new sterilization process.

anticipated_questions.question: Provide sterilization validation data for the new method, including SAL and any residuals testing.

tasks.title: Revalidate sterilization for new method
tasks.why_it_matters: Sterilization method change requires revalidation and review of residual limits, bioburden, and sterility assurance level.

acceptance_criteria: Provide accelerated aging study protocol and results.
If available, provide real-time aging data corroborating accelerated results.
Document acceptance criteria and test methods for aging endpoints.

anticipated_questions.question: Provide accelerated and/or real-time aging data supporting the claimed shelf life.

tasks.title: Provide shelf-life and aging study evidence
tasks.why_it_matters: New shelf-life claims require accelerated and/or real-time aging study data demonstrating device performance/safety over claimed period.

acceptance_criteria: Update IFU text to reflect any differences from predicate.
Add/update warnings and contraindications as applicable.
Verify claims in labeling are supported by verification/validation evidence.

anticipated_questions.question: Labeling/IFU appears misaligned with device differences. Confirm labeling has been updated.

tasks.title: Update labeling and IFU to reflect device differences
tasks.why_it_matters: Labeling or IFU requires updates to reflect device differences, warnings, contraindications, or changed operating procedures.

acceptance_criteria: Provide packaging integrity / seal strength test results.
Demonstrate sterile barrier maintained through distribution simulation.
If applicable, provide accelerated aging data supporting new packaging.

anticipated_questions.question: Has packaging integrity been validated with the new packaging system, including distribution simulation?

tasks.title: Verify packaging integrity and sterile barrier system
tasks.why_it_matters: Packaging system change requires integrity testing and may affect sterile barrier claims and shelf-life.
